title: Add an Allow Claude switch on each Mac, off until turned on there?

before.body: Options: a switch per Mac, off by default · on for every Mac that runs Tether, with no switch.

recommendation: Yes: since the passkey lock doesn't stop Claude, this switch is how a Mac opts in; it's one click per Mac, in the Tether panel
body: Options: a switch per Mac, off by default · on for every Mac that runs Tether, with no switch. If the answer is no switch, S-17 and Q-1 change: refusals come only from Pause, and R-7 gets no opt-in per Mac.

answer.text: Yes: since the passkey lock doesn't stop Claude, this switch is how a Mac opts in; it's one click per Mac, in the Tether panel
